name: Controllable Radiance Fields (CoRF)
definition: A method for generalizable, 3D-aware, and motion-controllable synthesis of face dynamics, generating never-before-seen faces with controlled dynamic motions and viewpoints.
summary: Controllable Radiance Fields is a method for generalizable, 3D-aware synthesis of face dynamics, extending NeRF by decoupling identity and motion to enable intuitive control over facial expressions and viewpoints.
